metadata.notes: A measured DSH v3 request/context record reports the selected model and its 262144-token window; the adapter maps both fields directly.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## What this cell asserts

This cell launches DeepSeek Harness with the recipe model `qwen/qwen3.5-9b`, completes one text-only turn, and requires the dashboard to report that exact model with a 262144-token context window. The lifecycle is `ready -> working -> ready`, with final state `ready` and no tool call.

## Agent support

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 records the resolved provider, model, and context window in its durable v3 transcript. A measured successful local turn contains `request/header.data.header.config.model = qwen/qwen3.5-9b`, followed by `request/context.data.model = qwen/qwen3.5-9b` and `request/context.data.contextWindow = 262144`. Its assistant record repeats the same source model and carries 7872 input tokens plus 26 output tokens. The completed `turn/end` follows that assistant record. This is direct evidence from the agent-owned durable record, not a value inferred from a daemon capacity table.

The model selection is also an active recipe input. The interactive driver writes a per-run DSH patch that selects provider `lmstudio`, model `qwen/qwen3.5-9b`, and context window `262144`, then launches `dsh --profile tui --patch <patch>`. The patch does not modify the installed profile. The measured record proves that DSH applied these values during a real turn.

## Daemon capability

The DSH adapter uses `FilesUnderRoot` over `session.vN.jsonl.zstd`. `parseRequestHeader` reads `data.header.config.model`. More importantly for this scenario, `parseRequestContext` reads `data.model` into `ModelName` and the direct `data.contextWindow` integer into `ContextWindow`. `parseAssistantMessage` independently reads `data.message.source.model` and usage. A completed `turn/end` maps to `turn_done`. Therefore the daemon does not need a model alias or capacity-table fallback for either acceptance metric.

The parser tests use the measured values. `TestParserMapsMeasuredRequestContext` asserts model `qwen/qwen3.5-9b` and context window `262144`. `TestZstdTranscriptEndToEnd` tails a compressed transcript and asserts the same final model and context window, `ContextWindowUnknown == false`, non-zero tokens, and terminal `turn_done`. This covers the parser-to-tailer metric path.

The factory observation verifier has a narrower export surface than the daemon. It exports `summary.model_name` and cumulative token fields for transcript adapters, but it exports `summary.context_window` only for antigravity's store-derived path. The spec can hard-assert the exact DSH model and non-zero tokens. It cannot hard-assert DSH context through `context_window_nonzero` without producing a false failure. The direct parser test and the live dashboard check in the recipe are therefore load-bearing for the exact context-window criterion. This is a factory verification limitation, not a daemon observability defect.

## Driver capability

The recipe needs `send`, `wait_turn`, and `sleep`. The DSH driver declares and implements all three. It resolves only a readable transcript created after its marker and with the fresh run cwd. `wait_turn` polls the durable transcript for the expected count of completed `turn/end` records. The post-turn sleep is 10 seconds, which matches the longest sibling settle delay. The timeout is 300 seconds because the measured local qwen turn took 157.8 seconds from `request/header` to `assistant/message`; the usual 120-180 second budgets do not give safe headroom here.

## Result

The cell is recordable. A recording must re-probe the local LM Studio endpoint and loaded model before launch, then confirm the exact model, the 262144-token window, no function call, and the lifecycle arc.
caveats: Vacuous-pass check: the factory phase and observation spec would still pass if only DSH ContextWindow propagation regressed, because the replay summary exports context_window only for antigravity. The live dashboard check and the compressed-transcript parser test are load-bearing for the exact 262144-token criterion; do not add context_window_nonzero to this DSH spec until the replay summary exports it for transcript adapters.

The lifecycle and metric assertions could pass after an auto-approved tool call because the phase DSL cannot reject function-call events. The exact-word prompt reduces this risk, and recording review must confirm that the curated event stream and transcript contain no tool/call record.

Load-bearing environment precondition: LM Studio must be listening at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 with qwen/qwen3.5-9b loaded. Re-probe this at record time. A different loaded model or endpoint behavior can invalidate the exact model assertion.
Load-bearing isolation precondition: the driver must retain its fresh per-run cwd and pre-launch marker. Otherwise an unrelated DSH transcript could satisfy the lifecycle phases.
The measured local turn took 157.8 seconds. A 120-180 second timeout can fail before the assistant record appears, so this recipe uses 300 seconds.

sources.note: Real DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 durable transcript. request/header and request/context report qwen/qwen3.5-9b; request/context reports contextWindow 262144; assistant/message repeats the model with 7872 input and 26 output tokens; turn/end reports completed. The measured model request took 157.8 seconds.

parseRequestHeader, parseRequestContext, and parseAssistantMessage map the three durable model carriers. parseRequestContext maps the direct contextWindow integer, and completed turn/end maps to turn_done.

TestParserMapsMeasuredRequestContext and TestZstdTranscriptEndToEnd assert qwen/qwen3.5-9b, ContextWindow 262144, ContextWindowUnknown false, usage, and terminal lifecycle through the compressed-transcript tailer.
Declares the compressed transcript FilesUnderRoot source, session identity, session.lock PID binding, and the model/context usage feature surface.
Creates the per-run LM Studio patch, launches DSH with it, isolates transcript discovery by marker and cwd, and implements send, wait_turn, and sleep.
The replay summary exports ModelName and cumulative tokens for every adapter but gates ContextWindow export to antigravity, which explains why the DSH spec must not set context_window_nonzero.

preconditions: dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 is installed and on PATH
the community TUI profile is installed under ~/.dsh/profiles/tui
re-probe at record time that LM Studio is listening at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 with qwen/qwen3.5-9b loaded
irrlichd is recording the deepseek-harness adapter
setup: The interactive driver creates a fresh cwd under the staging directory and sets a pre-launch transcript marker.
The driver applies a temporary patch that selects LM Studio, qwen/qwen3.5-9b, and context window 262144 without modifying the installed profile.
The driver resolves the new session.v3.jsonl.zstd by marker, header cwd, and parent session ID, then waits for a completed turn/end.

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: ok

verify: the same DSH session follows ready -> working -> ready and ends ready
the post-turn live dashboard reports ModelName qwen/qwen3.5-9b rather than unknown
the post-turn live dashboard reports ContextWindow 262144 and ContextWindowUnknown false
the replay golden reports model qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero cumulative tokens
the curated event stream and durable transcript contain no function call for the exact-word prompt
recipe.scope_note: Uses a 10-second post-turn settle delay, which matches the longest sibling recipe. Uses a 300-second timeout because the measured local qwen turn took 157.8 seconds.
